notes: Sourced directly from Roland's official V-600UHD Reference Manual PDF (static.roland.com), Main Specifications / Connectors section (p.48) plus Rear Panel section (p.4) for the AC IN connector. All HDMI I/O is HDMI 2.0 except MULTI-VIEW output which is HDMI 1.4; all SDI I/O is 12G/3G/HD-SDI (graded as sdi-12g, the highest supported tier). RGB IN 1 is an HD DB-15 (VGA-style) analog RGB input, mapped to the 'vga' connector id. TALLY/GPI is a DB-25 female connector (16 tally + 8 GPI channels) — DB-25 is not in the provided connector enum, so it was mapped to 'euroblock' as the closest generic multi-pin control/GPIO connector type; this is an approximation and should be treated as a caveat. USB MEMORY port is USB-A but functions only as a flash-drive slot for settings/still-image files, not a general USB host/data port — marked bidirectional per the schema's rule for USB host ports. AC power connector: the manual calls it "AC IN connector" on the rear panel (with cord hook and ground terminal) and lists "Power cord" as an included accessory (not an external brick/adapter), consistent with an IEC C13/C14-style inlet; mapped to 'iec'. Power consumption is 80 W; unit is 2U rack-mountable (482mm W x 300mm D x 109mm H, includes rack-mount angles as accessories).
